title: Darius Kazemi - Keeping Procedural Generation Interesting
speaker: Darius Kazemi
description:
Darius Kazemi talks about how to use randomness and procedural generation to create interesting content.
This video is from the 2017 Roguelike Celebration: https://roguelike.club/event2017.html
